name: Tra cuc
summary: Trà cúc is a glass of chrysanthemum, liquorice, and kumquat. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, on 24 July 2023, calls the taste bitter, sweet, and astringent at once, and compares the role to Hà Nội’s trà chanh without making them the same drink.
origin: Hai Phong. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, 24 July 2023.
taste: Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng names three tastes at once: bitter, sweet, and astringent, from chrysanthemum, liquorice, and kumquat.
howToEat: Drink it any time of day, often with bánh mì cay.
Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng prints 20,000–25,000 đồng a glass on 24 July 2023. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Phan Bội Châu, which Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng calls phố trà cúc. Counters sit one after another on that account. The hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng prints 20,000–25,000 đồng a glass on 24 July 2023.
